title: Vice President of Sales
description:
Vice President of Sales

Boulder, Colorado


Job Summary
The Vice President of Sales will be responsible for developing and executing the company's sales strategy, driving revenue growth, and expanding our customer base in the financial services and government sectors. Reporting directly to the CEO, the VP of Sales will lead a high-performing sales team, foster strategic partnerships, and ensure alignment with the company's overall business objectives. This role requires a proven leader with deep expertise in SaaS sales, a track record of exceeding revenue targets, and a passion for scaling innovative financial solutions.

Key Responsibilities:
Sales Strategy & Execution:
  • Develop and implement a comprehensive sales strategy to achieve revenue goals and expand market share in the financial services and government.
  • Identify and prioritize target markets, verticals, and customer segments for growth opportunities.
  • Drive the adoption of platform by effectively communicating its value proposition to prospects and clients.

Team Leadership & Development:
  • Lead, mentor, and scale a high-performing sales team, fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
  • Set clear performance metrics, provide coaching, and ensure team members are equipped to meet and exceed quotas.
  • Recruit and onboard top sales talent to support the company's growth objectives.

Revenue Growth & Pipeline Management
  • Oversee the entire sales cycle, from lead generation to deal closure, ensuring a robust and predictable sales pipeline.
  • Monitor and analyze sales performance metrics, using data-driven insights to optimize strategies and improve outcomes.
  • Negotiate high-value contracts and close strategic deals with enterprise clients.

Strategic Partnerships & Collaboration:
  • Build and maintain relationships with key stakeholders, including C-level executives, industry influencers, and strategic partners.
  • Collaborate with marketing, product, and customer success teams to align sales efforts with product offerings and customer needs.
  • Represent the company at industry events, conferences, and trade shows to enhance brand visibility and generate leads.

Market Insights & Innovation:
  • Stay informed on industry trends, competitor activities, and market demands to position company as a market leader.
  • Provide feedback to the product team to ensure the platform evolves to meet customer and market needs.

Qualifications:
  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Marketing, or a related field; MBA preferred.
  • 10+ years of sales experience in a B2B SaaS environment, with at least 5 years in a senior leadership role (e.g., VP, Director of Sales).
  • Proven track record of consistently achieving or exceeding revenue targets in the financial services or fintech industry.
  • Deep understanding of SaaS sales cycles, subscription-based revenue models, and enterprise deal structures.
  • Strong leadership skills with experience managing and scaling sales teams of 10+ members.
  • Exceptional communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.
  • Proficiency with CRM tools (HubSpot) and sales analytics platforms.
  • Strategic thinker with the ability to translate market insights into actionable sales plans.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and adapt to evolving business priorities.
  • Experience in the financial services industry or selling to finance-related roles (e.g., CFOs, finance directors) is a plus.

title: Mechanical Reliability Engineer
description:
The reliability team is seeking a Mechanical Reliability Engineer (MRE) for a period of 6 months.

Responsibilities include but not limited to the following:

  • Support troubleshooting efforts across the chemical plants
  • Working knowledge of ASME B31.3 and piping systems required.
  • Apply Mechanical Integrity principles to piping, tanks and pressure vessels
  • Evaluate corrosion, fatigue, wear, and erosion rates throughout the plant and initiate corrective actions as needed
  • Perform failure analysis on mechanical equipment and recommend long term reliability solutions
  • Utilize predictive maintenance tools such as vibration analysis for rotating equipment (pumps, motors, etc.)
  • Provide field support for mechanical troubleshooting and reliability improvement initiatives
  • Lead or participate in Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and drive actions to eliminate recurring failures
  • Apply and promote Reliability Engineering and Predictive Maintenance Technologies to enhance equipment performance and uptime.

title: Enterprise Architect
description:
Job Description
  • Demonstrated experience in developing and implementing technology strategies or enterprise policies for a large organization (preferably government or healthcare).
  • 10 years of progressively responsible experience in information technology (IT), strategy development, enterprise architecture or IT policy/governance.
  • Demonstrated experience coordinating with executive leadership and cross-functional teams to develop, review and finalize strategic or policy documents
  • Demonstrated experience of IT governance frameworks. E.g. National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST), Control Objectives for Information and Related Technologies (COBIT), Information Technology Infrastructure Library (ITIL) or The Open Group Architecture Framework (TOGAF).
  • Demonstrated experience with Florida Information Technology statutes and administrative codes.
  • Demonstrated experience writing executive-level documents, strategies and policies.
  • Demonstrated experience with facilitating and coordinating across diverse teams and stakeholder groups.
  • Demonstrated experience with Microsoft 365 (Word, PowerPoint, Excel, Teams, SharePoint) and collaboration tools (e.g. Smartsheet, Confluence or similar).
  • Demonstrated experience handling sensitive or confidential information.


RESPONSIBILITIES:


Perform the following tasks in the time and manner specified:

  • As directed by the Department; assist the Department with Technology Strategy Development. To include the following services:
    • Conduct assessments of current technology capabilities, challenges and opportunities.
    • Assist with defining technology vision, guiding principles and enterprise objectives.
    • Draft and maintain the Department Technology Strategy and Roadmap.
    • Align strategic priorities with statutory mandates, cybersecurity requirements and agency business needs.
    • Identify opportunities for modernization, consolidation and cost savings.
  • As directed by the Department; provide Policy & Standards Support. To include the following services:
    • Develop policies, standards and guidelines required to operationalize the technology strategy.
    • Ensure policies align with Chapter 282, F.S., Florida Administrative Code and enterprise standards.
    • Manage policy lifecycle (drafting, comment resolution, finalization, approval and communication).
    • Provide CIO and Department staff with policy packets, briefing materials and communications.
  • As directed by the Department; provide Coordination & Governance. To include the following services:
    • Organize and facilitate technology strategy working groups with Division and County HealthDepartment (CHD) Information Technology (IT) leadership.
    • Provide agendas, meeting minutes and track action items.
    • Coordinate with external stakeholders.
    • Maintain stakeholder maps, charts and issue/risk logs to ensure accountability.
  • As directed by the Department; assist the Department with Reporting & Communication. To include the following services:
    • Prepare weekly CIO status updates on strategy and policy progress.
    • Develop dashboards to track initiatives, policies, risks and milestones.
    • Create executive briefing decks and communications materials for leadership.
    • Support legislative and enterprise reporting requirements as directed.

title: Business Analyst - Lead
description:
Job Title: Business Analyst--Team Lead

Serves as a liaison between the business community and the IT organization in order to provide technical solutions to meet user needs. Possesses expertise in the business unit(s) they support, as well as, an understanding of the IT organization's systems and capabilities. Analyzes business partner's operations to understand their strengths and weaknesses to determine opportunities to automate processes and functions.

Assists in the business process redesign and documentation as needed for new technology. Translates high level business requirements into functional specifications for the IT organization and manages changes to such specifications. Educates the IT organization on the direction of the business. Negotiates agreements and commitments by facilitating communication between business unit(s) and IT from initial requirements to final implementation. Possesses an understanding of technological trends and uses this knowledge to bring solutions to business units supported to enhance the enterprise's competitive edge. May make recommendations for buy vs. build decision.

Dimensions Education:

Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Administration, or other related field. Or equivalent work experience.

Experience:

A minimum of 5 years of relevant technical or business work experience.

Complexity:

Intermediate professional level role. Works with business partners within one business function to align technology solutions with business strategies. Demonstrates an informed knowledge of a business area to resolve problems on an ongoing business. Supports several moderately complex business processes. Works on multiple projects as a project team member, occasionally as a project leader. May coach more junior staff.

title: Development Manager
description:
Our client is a Series "A” B2B software company (50 people) based in Boulder, CO, with a lean, senior-heavy Engineering team. They ship a data-intensive product used by accounting/forensic teams, and they need stronger weekly execution and capacity planning.


Development Manager (Agile Delivery)

Responsibilities:
  • Own the week-to-week Agile engine for a senior, cross-functional Engineering team.
  • You'll be technical-first (able to read code, reason about architecture, and challenge estimates) while running the delivery cadence: capacity planning, predictable sprints, crisp handoffs, and on-time, high-quality releases.
Sprint & Capacity Management
  • Run backlog refinement with Product; convert roadmap into groomed, sized work
  • Build and maintain capacity models per engineer; forecast 1–3 sprints out; manage load vs. priorities.
  • Lead standups, planning, and reviews; keep WIP limits healthy; drive burndown/burnup transparency.
Technical Delivery Leadership
  • Validate estimates with leads; spot dependency/complexity risk; decompose epics into testable slices.
  • Facilitate design/PR review flow; ensure definition of ready/done, coding standards, and CI gates are applied.
  • Partner with Tech Leads on release planning, change control, and rollout/rollback strategies.
Quality & Reliability
  • Embed test strategy (unit/integration/e2e) into planning; track defect escape rate and fix-forward SLAs.
  • Coordinate incident response runbooks, postmortems, and action-item follow-through.
Cross-Functional Orchestration
  • Run the Dev→QA→Release→Customer handoff with Product, Support, and Customer Success.
  • Improve ticket hygiene, documentation, and "one source of truth” in our dev toolchain.
Continuous Improvement
  • Own retros that produce 2–3 measurable experiments per sprint (flow efficiency, cycle time, predictability).
  • Instrument delivery health: velocity, throughput, cycle/lead time, blocker aging, unplanned work %.
Experience
  • Technical foundation: Former senior/staff engineer or EM who still reads code, can navigate repos, and discuss tradeoffs (perf, scalability, data integrity).
  • Delivery chops: 5–8+ years in Agile delivery for SaaS/data products; proven record turning roadmaps into shipped software on a weekly cadence.
  • Systems thinker: You model capacity, defend focus, and reduce multitasking/hidden WIP.
  • Calm operator: You reduce chaos for senior engineers and unblock quickly without micromanaging.
  • Tooling fluency: Jira (or Linear), GitHub/GitLab, CI/CD, feature flags, basic observability (logs/metrics/traces).
  • Nice-to-haves: Experience in data pipelines/ETL, security/compliance environments, or finance/forensic domains; prior startup or Denver/Boulder ecosystem experience.
Operating cadence you'll run
  • Weekly: backlog refinement, sprint planning, daily standup, risk review, demo, retro.
  • Biweekly: release train/go-no-go with Tech Leads + Product.
  • Monthly: capacity/velocity review with CTO; staffing/contractor recommendations.

Work mode: Hybrid preferred (2–3 days in Boulder/Denver); remote considered for outstanding candidates in Central/Mountain Time Zone

title: Supply Chain Support Coordinator
description:
JOB SUMMARY:

The Supply Chain Support Coordinator provides essential support for daily operations in logistics, inventory management, and customer service. Responsibilities include preparing reports, performing reconciliations, and assisting with order fulfillment to ensure accuracy and timely service for internal and external customers.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:
  • Support daily logistics operations under the direction of the Logistics Manager.
  • Assist with order processing and shipment tracking.
  • Maintain and update item databases.
  • Prepare and distribute electronic data exchanges.
  • Respond to customer and employee correspondence and emails.
  • Assist with inventory control and purchase order generation.
  • Provide backup support to the customer service department as needed.
  • Deliver internal support for logistics-related tasks.
  • Participate in special projects as assigned.

Education and Experience Requirements:
  • High school diploma or equivalent required; some college coursework in business, communications, or related field preferred.
  • Minimum one year of office or warehouse shipping experience required.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel required.
  • Experience with Microsoft Business Central, Power BI, and Koerber One WMS preferred.

Knowledge/Skills/Abilities:
  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Reliable and punctual; consistently meets deadlines.
  • Works effectively under direct supervision.
  • Organized and able to manage tasks within tight deadlines.
  • Delivers high-quality customer service and builds positive relationships.
  • Able to research and resolve basic shipping and logistics issues.
  • Collaborative team member with strong interpersonal skills.
  • Communicates clearly, primarily via email using company templates.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office and internal systems/CRM.

title: Escrow Manager
description:
Ensuring smooth and secure real estate closings for all involved in the transaction.
Our Client is where real estate closings meet precision, care, and teamwork. For over 20 years, their full-service title and settlement professionals have partnered with homebuilding and mortgage teams to deliver seamless, on-time closings.

This position is 100% in-office in Scottsdale, AZ.

JOB SUMMARY:


Responsible for achieving branch strategic and financial objectives by establishing and overseeing efficient closing/settlement processes, developing internal and external customer relationships, preparing and maintaining branch budgets and managing and developing branch staff.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:
  • Ensure daily branch operations are conducted in accordance with operations standards
  • Establish and monitor processes for accurate and timely processing of title, scheduling, closing preparation, closing and post-closing
  • Ensure quality customer service. Monitor and respond to customer service management system (CQE).
  • Serve as point of contact for customer questions and concerns as needed
  • Prepare and adhere to departmental budgets with focus on expense reduction and maximizing revenue
  • Perform as a team member in allocating and coordinating the workflow
  • Maintain thorough and current knowledge of all federal, state, and local regulations as well as internal policies and procedures
  • Keep abreast of area competitors' products, services and costs
  • Maintain and foster branch participation in division/community events and promote values and culture
  • Act as liaison between all parties to the transaction within the Title & Settlement Process
  • Handle all aspects of the settlement transactions and facilitate closings
  • Follow Escrow Accounting Business Practice Guidelines while complying States Good Funds Statutes.
  • Review escrow quality assurance reports and resolve to outstanding issues to ensure compliance with required business policy
  • Perform other duties as assigned
REQUIRED EDUCATION
  • Minimum High School Diploma or equivalent
  • Licensing requirements as required by State/Federal Agencies
  • Notary Public license requirements as required by State
REQUIRED EXPERIENCE
  • Related Functional Experience: Minimum of 3-5 years Escrow Operations Experience
  • Supervisory Minimum of 2 years at a supervisory level or above.
  • Specialize in RESPA with understanding of company's underwriting guidelines
  • Understanding of title and settlement rules and regulations
  • Effective communication, presentation, and organization skills
  • Capacity to work in a multi- location team environment
  • Ability to prioritize conflicting demands & meet department needs with available resources
  • Efficient in Microsoft Windows, Outlook, Excel, One Note and Softpro is a plus
  • Loyal: Shows firm and constant support to a cause
  • Team Player: Works well as a member of a group
  • Functional Expert: Considered a thought leader on a subject
  • Self-Starter: Inspired to perform without outside help
  • Goal Completion: Inspired to perform well by the completion of objectives
  • Resolve complex problems and execute complex transactions as needed

title: Cabling Manager - Low Voltage
description:
Job Title: Cabling Manager (Low Voltage)
Position Summary
The Cabling Manager (Low Voltage) oversees the design, installation, and maintenance of structured cabling systems that support voice, data, video, and security technologies. This role ensures all low-voltage cabling projects are completed on time, within budget, and in compliance with industry standards and client specifications. The ideal candidate combines strong technical knowledge with leadership and project management skills.
Key Responsibilities
  • Project Management:
    • Plan, schedule, and manage multiple low-voltage cabling projects from initiation to completion.
    • Coordinate with clients, contractors, and internal teams to define project scope and deliverables.
    • Ensure all installations comply with NEC, EIA/TIA, BICSI, and local building codes.
  • Team Leadership:
    • Supervise and mentor cabling technicians and subcontractors.
    • Assign daily tasks, conduct quality checks, and ensure adherence to safety procedures.
    • Train team members on installation techniques, testing procedures, and industry best practices.
  • Technical Oversight:
    • Oversee installation of copper and fiber optic cabling, patch panels, racks, and related infrastructure.
    • Manage labeling, testing, and documentation for all installed systems.
    • Troubleshoot, repair, and optimize cabling systems as needed.
  • Quality & Compliance:
    • Conduct site surveys and ensure project documentation accuracy.
    • Enforce adherence to safety standards (OSHA) and company quality control procedures.
    • Maintain inventory of materials, tools, and test equipment.
  • Client Communication:
    • Serve as the primary point of contact for clients during project execution.
    • Provide progress reports, resolve issues, and ensure client satisfaction.
Qualifications
  • Education:
    • High school diploma or GED required; Associate's or Bachelor's degree in Telecommunications, Electrical Engineering, or related field preferred.
  • Experience:
    • 5+ years of experience in structured cabling, telecommunications, or low-voltage systems.
    • 2+ years in a supervisory or project management role.
  • Certifications (Preferred):
    • BICSI Technician or RCDD Certification
    • OSHA 30 Safety Certification
    • Manufacturer certifications (Panduit, CommScope, Corning, etc.)
  • Skills:
    • Strong understanding of structured cabling design, installation, and testing.
    • Proficient in reading blueprints, schematics, and construction documents.
    • Excellent organizational and communication skills.
    • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
    • Proficiency with project management tools and Microsoft Office Suite.
Other Titles you may see: Maintenance Engineer/Manager, Plant Engineer/Manager, Asset Engineer/Manager, Asset Integrity Engineer/Manager, Rotating Equipment Engineer/Manager, Equipment Specialist/Engineer/Manager...
